title: SEBI to issue consultation paper on derivatives settlement price methodology on Saturday
text: SEBI to issue consultation paper on derivatives settlement price methodology on Saturday. The Securities and Exchange Board of India will issue a consultation paper to refine settlement price methodology for derivative contracts. Following the Closing Auction Session’s impact, SEBI seeks to improve market practices.
